sources.title: Tiny Aya Earth model card
sources.evidence: Exact Earth card identifies Cohere and Cohere Labs, open weights, 3.35B size, text input/output, and West Asian/African specialization. Lists CC-BY-NC-4.0 with acceptable-use conditions. Its isolated 111B terms boilerplate conflicts with its size specification and the technical report. Reopened October 27, 2026: the exact card still explicitly states 3.35B and provides no separate active count.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth (March 12, 2026), sections 3.1-3.3 and Table 2
sources.evidence: Names Earth as the Africa/West Asia regional variant. Defines a dense decoder-only Transformer; Table 2 specifies 3.35B total, 36 layers, 2048 embedding dimensions, and 8192 input/output context. Regional checkpoints retain the shared architecture through parameter-space merging. Reports prompted chain-of-thought evaluations, not an Earth-specific thinking API. Independently inspected the complete freshly fetched October 27 report, including sections 3.1–3.3 and comparison tables. Table 2 distinguishes 0.5B embedding, 2.8B non-embedding and 3.35B total parameters; these are not labeled active. The shared architecture and direct parameter-space merging support the regional nominal total, with no separate active-count convention.

sources.title: Cohere Labs Launches Tiny Aya, Making Multilingual AI Accessible
sources.evidence: Launch article dated February 17, 2026. Its HTML article payload explicitly includes TinyAya-Earth among released regional variants for Africa and West Asia; structured datePublished is 2026-02-17T04:00:07.000-05:00. Article body required reading the embedded HTML payload because the text extractor omitted it.

sources.title: Official Tiny Aya Earth repository metadata and tokenizer template
sources.evidence: Exact repository metadata at revision 0624fafbe200f930b89566fc4ec4da314ba48d89 identifies Cohere2ForCausalLM and base_model CohereLabs/tiny-aya-base. The exposed template handles system/user/assistant text without tool definitions, tool-call serialization, or a thinking branch. Host-generated safetensors metadata reports 3349227520 BF16 elements; raw tensors were gated, so this is not an independently validated learned-parameter count. Fresh October 27 API read returns the same revision, base-model mapping and 3,349,227,520-element aggregate; this corroborates the nominal total without being used as an active count.

sources.title: Tiny Aya documentation: Model Variants
sources.evidence: Official five-model family table explicitly lists tiny-aya-earth with 3.35B parameters, 8k context/output, 70 languages and West Asian/African focus. Identifies instruction-tuned variants as available through Chat and as open weights. Does not specify Earth-native thinking or tool calling. Reopened October 27: the exact Earth row still lists 3.35B under Parameters, without an active-parameter field.

sources.title: Cohere2 Transformer implementation, Transformers v4.57.1
sources.evidence: The exact architecture class named by Earth metadata uses Cohere2Attention plus a dense Cohere2MLP with gate/up/down linear projections in each decoder layer, without expert routing. Corroborates the technical report rather than transferring model-size settings from another checkpoint.

sources.title: Basic usage of tool use (function calling)
sources.evidence: Official tool-use overview describes Command-family tool calling and demonstrates Command A+. It does not establish capability for tiny-aya-earth merely because Earth also uses the Chat endpoint.

sources.evidence: Defines dedicated thinking content blocks and controls, demonstrated with command-a-reasoning-08-2025. It does not identify Tiny Aya Earth as a supported reasoning model.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Base model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the exact base named by Earth metadata confirms the nominal 3.35B model. The base card publishes no separate active-count definition; the named-base relationship cannot supply an otherwise undisclosed active field.

sources.title: Introducing Command A+
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the later first-party model comparison. The explicit 218B total and 25B active figures describe Command A+, while Tiny Aya Earth and its base are absent. No applicable active-count convention is established.

sources.title: In-Language Reasoning: Data Mixing Bridges
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 search found and read this October 2026 first-party article about Tiny Aya L2-Thinker. It identifies a 3.35B model built on the 32K Tiny Aya base and compares reasoning efficiency, but supplies no separate active count for Earth or its base. Thinker capabilities and context are not transferred to Earth.

sources.title: Building Multilingual Bridges: Data Mixing as the Pillar of Generalization for In-Language Reasoning
sources.evidence: Freshly fetched and independently inspected the full September 2026 report, including base-model section 3.1 and all parameter terminology and comparison headings. It describes Tiny Aya at 3.35B scale and provides benchmark/token-efficiency comparisons; no Earth/base active-parameter count or dense active-count convention is stated.

sources.title: Tiny Aya L2-Thinker model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of this later family release confirms its 3.35B nominal size and named Tiny Aya base. It does not separately report active parameters; its reasoning mode and 32K context belong to that later variant and are not inherited by Earth.

developer.note: Cohere and its Cohere Labs research group are credited; existing developer name is accurate.

family.note: Normalized family key for the explicitly named Tiny Aya five-model family.

release_date.note: Dated developer launch includes Earth. Repository creation on February 13 is not public-release evidence; later technical report is not the release date.

open_weights.note: Weights are offered under noncommercial terms with an agreement gate; open weights does not mean unrestricted open-source licensing.

license.note: Confirmed named license; acceptable-use addendum and Cohere Labs acceptable-use policy also apply.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 card, documentation, metadata and full report checks confirm Cohere's nominal 3.35B total for Earth. Shared architecture and regional parameter-space merging preserve that published count. Hub metadata corroborates the scale at 3.349227520B; an exact tensor census is not required to retain nominal precision. The isolated 111B terms boilerplate is inconsistent with the exact size specification and report.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total/active/activated and lineage searches, original evidence and later first-party comparisons found no separate active count for Earth or its named base. Table 2's 2.8B is explicitly non-embedding, not active. The later Thinker report and cards publish nominal size and reasoning efficiency without an active-count convention; A+ counts describe another model. Dense architecture alone does not justify filling the field.

architecture.note: Technical report explicitly says dense decoder-only Transformer, and regional models share its architecture. Exact Earth metadata maps to Cohere2ForCausalLM; its implementation has dense MLPs, corroborating the classification.

context_window.note: Table 2 gives input context as exactly 8192 tokens for the shared architecture, resolving the 8k shorthand. Output is separately 8192; the figures are not added.

modalities.note: Exact Earth card explicitly specifies text-only input and text output.

reasoning.note: Prompted chain-of-thought performance and general reasoning ability are documented, but an Earth-specific dedicated thinking mode or explicit absence is not established. Its exposed template has no thinking branch. Clear baseline false rather than promote inference from absence to verified capability metadata.

tool_call.note: No exact-model primary documentation establishes native tool calling. Earth template lacks tools/tool_calls handling; general Chat endpoint availability and Command-family tool support do not verify Earth. Clear unsupported baseline true.

description.value: Compact multilingual model specialized for West Asian and African languages
description.note: Concise description accurately states the exact Earth specialization without transferring Global, Fire or Water claims.

patch.notes: Tiny Aya Earth is the Africa/West Asia regional variant with a nominal 3.35B total and 8192-token input context. Active parameters are not separately disclosed; the report's 2.8B non-embedding count is a different measure. The card's isolated 111B terms boilerplate conflicts with its model specification. Dedicated thinking and native tool-calling support remain unverified for Earth. CC-BY-NC-4.0 includes acceptable-use conditions.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit confirms nominal 3.35B total and retains an undisclosed active count. Reopened the exact Earth card, documentation, metadata and named-base card; independently inspected the original report and later Command A+ comparison, Thinker release and September technical report. No active-count convention was found, and non-embedding parameters are not relabeled active. Added explicit parameter patches and refreshed evidence while preserving unrelated assessments.
